text.en:
The Jolo Elementary School Unit I located at Barangay Barangka Drive, Municipality of
Mandaluyong, Metro Manila, is hereby renamed Bonifacio Javier Elementary School in honor of the late
Bonifacio Javier, Mayor of Mandaluyong from 1961 to 1965.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: April 13, 1984
